title: Switching booking apps without stopping service
titleZh: 不中斷服務地切換預約系統
passage: Our new booking app rolls out Monday. Green on the tracker means your test arrived. Wait for IT approval before choosing a slot. Monday teams need a spare computer for the full twenty minutes. Remote teams must reserve loan computers by Friday. Other approved teams switch Wednesday. We’re changing tyres while the bus keeps moving. The old app works on computers not being updated. If your working computer fails, the service desk takes new bookings. Only your team can finish bookings already open.
passageZh: 我們的新預約系統從星期一開始上線。進度表顯示綠色，只代表收到了你們的測試。選時段前，要先等資訊部門核准。安排在星期一切換的團隊，整整二十分鐘都要有一台備用電腦。遠端團隊要借電腦，最晚要在星期五預約。其他已獲核准的團隊改在星期三切換。這就像公車還在開，我們就得換輪胎。沒有在更新的電腦仍可使用舊系統。如果手邊正在用的電腦故障，服務櫃檯可以接手新的預約。已經開始處理的預約，只有你們自己的團隊能完成。
